title: Mobile Game Ads
description: Obnoxious advertisements for your favorite game.
body: # Usage When using this datapack, keep in mind that you must be careful. Move the datapack to your datapacks folder and open the world to begin. Around every 30 seconds you will get an ad, and will have to wait around 9 seconds to move, attack, see farther than four blocks, and break blocks. This datapack adds a whole new speedrunning challenge. # Credits This datapack was made almost all by myself. The only component that wasn't made by me is the base random number generator. The source can be found [here](https://www.reddit.com/r/MinecraftCommands/comments/vv68n6/tutorial_random_number_generator_by_scoreboard/)[.](https://media.tenor.com/mhLPO2VldCkAAAAM/0001.gif) # License This datapack is licensed under the [MIT License](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BlueFalconHD/minecraft-datapack-mobilegame/main/LICENSE). # Issues Please submit clear and concise issue reports. # Thanks! Thank you for trying this datapack. I know it isn't great, I was rushed.
